notes: D&D face: the lens opens a weapon wheel (name, to-hit, dice on each wedge); the sword button beside it attacks
D&D attack: press ROLL to roll (the knob click too); ADV / DIS sit under the weapon's name and toggle one or the other
Home: the Magic / D&D pill sits higher; tapping into Magic lands straight on a one-player 20-life face
D&D sheet: any weapon or armour can be picked -- the sheet shows what you are not trained in (no proficiency bonus; armour penalties)
D&D party: the DM hosts, players join; DM damage/heal/area; players heal each other
